summary: Add pkg/automation/mcpops: MCP operations of automations for agents (automation_catalog, automation_list, automation_get, automation_runs, automation_run_get, automation_validate, automation_dry_run as read-only tools; automation.create/update/layout as guarded changes; HUMAN_REQUIRED for enabling, and NativeGuard for mcptools.Deps.HumanOnly so extruntime workflow actions on automation instances and tasks need a person). Engine: Authoring.Validate, DryRunInput.MaxCalls, ListFilter.Attention, engine.WithTx, and a layout revision (Automation.LayoutRevision; SaveLayout now takes LayoutInput{BaseRevision, Positions} and returns the new revision, a stale base is a LayoutConflictError). changes.Applied gains Result, returned in the receipt item.
